message:
Avoid extraineous complexes.

When getting agent pairs, complex results show up in
all their permutations. Make it so they only show up
once, and preferably such that they will almost always
show up with the agents that were queried (because
there will in general be more examples of such).

This is done by not returning agent JSONs for which
all represented hashes are complexes that have already
been represented. This means the limits and offsets no
longer directly map to those sent to the database,
which was long maintained for simplicity. However,
the machinery already existed to supply a custom offset
for the next page in the response, which is now once
again utilized in this case.

To allow for continued filtering across paging, the
complex hashes that were already displayed are sent as
part of the response, and it is recommended that paging
queries return this set in the next query as part of
the class initialization.

message:
Avoid extraineous complexes.

When getting agent pairs, complex results show up in
all their permutations. Make it so they only show up
once, and preferably such that they will almost always
show up with the agents that were queried (because
there will in general be more examples of such).

This is done by not returning agent JSONs for which
all represented hashes are complexes that have already
been represented. This means the limits and offsets no
longer directly map to those sent to the database,
which was long maintained for simplicity. However,
the machinery already existed to supply a custom offset
for the next page in the response, which is now once
again utilized in this case.

To allow for continued filtering across paging, the
complex hashes that were already displayed are sent as
part of the response, and it is recommended that paging
queries return this set in the next query as part of
the class initialization.

reported to s3 by each job, and aggregated by the managing machine.

author: Jakub Kaczmarzyk <jakub.kaczmarzyk@gmail.com>
message:
expanduser in basepath and outdir

Closes https://github.com/choosehappy/HistoQC/issues/197

When using a path with a tilde `~` on unix-like systems, the path is
interpreted as a literal `./~`, meaning a directory named `~` in the
current working directory. Users typically do not want this and would
probably be surprised by this behavior. I know I was surprised when I
ran histoqc and then saw a new directory named `~`. I removed it very
carefully, trying to be sure I didn't trash my home directory :)

This commit fixes the issue by expanding the tilde into the path to the
home directory. If a path does not begin with a tilde, the path is
unchanged.

author: Jakub Kaczmarzyk <jakub.kaczmarzyk@gmail.com>
message:
use multi-stage build in Dockerfile to halve size

This commit proposes using a multi-stage Dockerfile. In the first stage,
we use the official python:3.8 image, which includes a C compilers. We
install the project and its dependencies. We create a dedicated virtual
environment for the project. Then in the second stage, we copy over the
project files and the python virtual environment, and we install
libopenslide0, which is required for openslide-python runtime.

This results in a more complex Dockerfile, but the resulting image is
half as big as the original (671 MB from about 1.3GB). I am also happy
to maintain this Dockerfile and answer any questions about it.

    carray = bcolz.carray(rootdir = os.path.join(path, name), mode='r')

4     F821 undefined name 'Module'
4

__E901,E999,F821,F822,F823__ are the "_showstopper_" [flake8](http://flake8.pycqa.org) issues that can halt the runtime with a SyntaxError, NameError, etc. Most other flake8 issues are merely "style violations" -- useful for readability but they do not effect runtime safety.
* F821: undefined name `name`
* F822: undefined name `name` in `__all__`
* F823: local variable name referenced before assignment
* E901: SyntaxError or IndentationError
* E999: SyntaxError -- failed to compile a file into an Abstract Syntax Tree

author: Ne-oL <38661257+Ne-oL@users.noreply.github.com>
message:
Update decision_regions.py

found that the bottleneck for the decision_regions drawing was due to the slow prediction. to fix it, i added ray parallelization and distributed the iterative prediction on all available CPUs (local or within cluster). i have tested the changes and so far there doesn't seem to be any issues. the speed gain i measured on a small dataset was 21X the original (449 seconds vs 21 seconds on local HPC instance of 36 cores). the large dataset >2,000 input took days(>5 days) to draw, now its taking ~12 minutes on a HPC Cluster (72CPUs). 
unfortunately, due to not being a programmer, I think my implementation needs a lot of optimization and its definitely not the most pythonic way.
I failed to implement the parallelization using python multiprocessing module due to pickling issue. hence using ray algorithm.

add support for newer pandas sparse dataframes in frequent_patterns

SparseDataFrame has been deprecated, pandas now recommands to create
standard DataFrames and store sparse Series as SparseArray.  This
allows to combine both dense and sparse columns.

Improve valid_input_check with sparse values; it previously uncompressed
the whole dataframe to check for invalid values, which defeats its purpose.
It now only checks existing values, which prevents memory error, and is
also much faster.

Update apriori.ipynb notebook to use the new pandas sparse DataFrame.

author: Carl Smedstad <carl.smedstad@protonmail.com>
message:
Don't include tests in built wheel

Tests should be included in the source distribution but there is no
reason to include them in the build wheel.

Disable implicit packages (directories without an __init__.py file)
altogether by setting the following in pyproject.toml:

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
include = ["mlxtend", "mlxtend.*"]
namespaces = false

author: Denis Barbier <barbier@imacs.polytechnique.fr>
message:
let fpgrowth and fpmax work directly with sparse input (#622)

* let fpgrowth and fpmax work directly with sparse input

If transactions are stored in a sparse matrix, it was first converted
into a dense Numpy array in setup_fptree before processing.

This commit allows to build the FPTree directly from sparse input, which
may save memory and processing time.  This is used by both fpgrowth and
fpmax.  There is no change after FPTree is being built.

* in setup_fptree, ensure that sparse DataFrame has no zeroes

In a212806 we assumed that all values in sparse DataFrame are non null,
which should always be true.  In order to avoid this corner case, we
now call itemsets.eliminate_zeros().  The alternative would be to replace
   nonnull = itemsets.indices[itemsets.indptr[i]:itemsets.indptr[i+1]]
by
   values = itemsets.data[itemsets.indptr[i]:itemsets.indptr[i+1]]
   nonnull = itemsets.indices[itemsets.indptr[i] + values.nonzero()[0]]
but it is slower.

Add a test case.

* fix pep8 issue

author: Tim Kellogg <tim@kensci.com>
message:
Fix fpgrowth for sparse matrices

While this function technically supports sparse matrices, it calls
`pd.DataFrame.values` in order to get the number of rows in the
DataFrame. Unfortunately, `.values` forces the entire DataFrame to be
converted into a non-sparse 2D numpy array, which obliviates the whole
purpose behind using a sparse matrix in the first place. It's a simple
fix though.

author: Denis Barbier <barbier@imacs.polytechnique.fr>
message:
in setup_fptree, ensure that sparse DataFrame has no zeroes

In a212806 we assumed that all values in sparse DataFrame are non null,
which should always be true.  In order to avoid this corner case, we
now call itemsets.eliminate_zeros().  The alternative would be to replace
   nonnull = itemsets.indices[itemsets.indptr[i]:itemsets.indptr[i+1]]
by
   values = itemsets.data[itemsets.indptr[i]:itemsets.indptr[i+1]]
   nonnull = itemsets.indices[itemsets.indptr[i] + values.nonzero()[0]]
but it is slower.

Add a test case.

author: Denis Barbier <barbier@imacs.polytechnique.fr>
message:
Let apriori always use low_memory processing

Thanks to previous optimizations, processing with low_memory=True is
now as efficient as with low_memory=False, and allows to process much
larger datasets.

Removing processing with low_memory=False makes code simpler.

The downside is that we do not know in advance the number of itemsets to
process, thus it is displayed afterwards.  We now display the number of
itemsets after prune step.
Note that commit 2f928cb introduced a bug, the number of processing
combinations was multiplied by itemset's length.

Since vectorized operations are no more performed on frequent itemsets,
they are stored as list of tuples.

into a dense Numpy array in setup_fptree before processing.

This commit allows to build the FPTree directly from sparse input, which
may save memory and processing time.  This is used by both fpgrowth and
fpmax.  There is no change after FPTree is being built.

change max_score - line 243

Change max_score in line 243 to accommodate smaller negative values. For example, when using 'mean_squared_error', the call to get_scorer results in a make_scorer function with 'greater_is_better = False', such that values less than -1 can occur (the sign is flipped on the result of mse). Changed to float('-inf'), or could be -10**9, etc.

author: James Bourbeau <jrbourbeau@gmail.com>
message:
Updates plot_decision_regions to support >2 features

plot_decision_regions should behave exactly the same for the case when
the number of training features (X.shape[1]) is 1 or 2. This commit
adds the additional keyword arguments feature_index and
filler_feature_dict. Feature_index is an array-like object with two
items that specify the features indices in X to be plotted on the
x and y axis of the decision regions plot. Filler_feature_dict is a
dictionary of feature index-value pairs that will be filled in for the
features not on the x and y axis.

author: Iaroslav Shcherbatyi <iaroslav.github@gmail.com>
message:
Inheritance in OnehotTransactions

The following
```python
from sklearn.base import clone
from mlxtend.preprocessing import OnehotTransactions
enc = OnehotTransactions()
clone(enc)
```
raises
```
TypeError: Cannot clone object '<mlxtend.preprocessing.onehot.OnehotTransactions object at 0x7f11d8ed7a90>' (type <class 'mlxtend.preprocessing.onehot.OnehotTransactions'>): it does not seem to be a scikit-learn estimator as it does not implement a 'get_params' methods.
```
because the class does not inherit from base classes in sklearn.
This is a fix

author: Denis Barbier <barbier@imacs.polytechnique.fr>
message:
Apriori: implement join step of apriori-gen

The apriori-gen function described in section 2.1.1 of Apriori paper
has two steps; first, the join step looks for itemsets with the same
prefix, and creates new candidates by appending all pairs combinations
to this prefix. Here is pseudocode copied from paper:

  select p.1, p.2, ..., p.k-1, q.k-1
  from p in L(k-1), q in L(k-1)
  where p.1 = q.1, ..., p.k-2 = q.k-2, p.k-1 < q.k-1

The reason is that if a sequence q with the same prefix as p does not
belong to L(k-1), itemset p+(q.k-1,) cannot be frequent.
Before this commit, we were considering p+(q.k-1,) for any q.k-1 > p.k-1.

The second step of apriori-gen function is called prune step, it will
be implemented in a distinct commit.

See discussion in #644.

message:
Apriori: implement prune step of apriori-gen

The apriori-gen function described in section 2.1.1 of Apriori paper
has two steps; the first step had been implemented in previous commit.

The second step of apriori-gen function is called prune step, it takes
candidates c from first step and check that all (k-1) tuples built by
removing any single element from c is in L(k-1).

As Numpy arrays are not hashable, we cannot use set() for itemset lookup,
and define a very simple prefix tree class.

author: Denis Barbier <barbier@imacs.polytechnique.fr>
message:
add support for newer pandas sparse dataframes in frequent_patterns (#621)

* add support for newer pandas sparse dataframes in frequent_patterns

SparseDataFrame has been deprecated, pandas now recommands to create
standard DataFrames and store sparse Series as SparseArray.  This
allows to combine both dense and sparse columns.

Improve valid_input_check with sparse values; it previously uncompressed
the whole dataframe to check for invalid values, which defeats its purpose.
It now only checks existing values, which prevents memory error, and is
also much faster.

Update apriori.ipynb notebook to use the new pandas sparse DataFrame.

* use pandas version number to detect new sparse dataframes

* limitations on columns of sparse DaraFrame still apply

Contrary to what I thought in 0a8fa8f, this issue is still not fixed.

* fix bug introduced by commit 22915a8 with empty DataFrame

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1152: Remove input browse context from translate_browse_path

The browse context used to compute browse result is established through
the operation set_browse_value_context at the level of browse_treatment
component. At the level translate_browse_path, this browse context is
not modified : indeed, a browse context is set and cleared within the
local operation compute_browse_result_from_source. Therefore, variables
related to browse context, specified by the definition
d_var_browse_value_in, shall be removed from postcondition of operations
in translate_browse_path component.

Note that at the level of translate_browse_path, browse context is
always undefined. Invariant or pre/post-condition should be added to
make PO provable. This will be done in an another commit.

author: monfort <vincent.monfort@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #547: Minor change: timeoutHint verification is not required to use request timestamp

We used the request timestamp to check the elapsed time since request was sent in order to evaluate the timeoutHint of publihs requets.
Since it is not required by the OPCUA spec part 4, we should not use the request timestamp and only use the current local time as reference for timeout.
It avoids clock synchronization issue between client and server.

OPC UA spec part 4:
- request timestamp definition:
  "The time the Client sent the request. The parameter is only used for diagnostic and logging purposes in the server."
  => i.e.: the server shall not use it for a functional behavior (e.g.: compute publish request timeout ...)
- request timeoutHint definition:
  "For a Server this timeout is only a hint and can be used to cancel long running operations to free resources."
  "The Server shall check the timeoutHint parameter of a Publish request before processing a Publish response."

Ticket #1062: Bring up precond of setall_browse_value_context

The precond 'p_maxTargetRef <= k_n_BrowseTarget_max' is required by the
operation setall_browse_value_context. In the level of browse_treatment,
this operation is called by operations set_browse_value_context and
set_browse_value_context_from_continuation_point.

For set_browse_value_context: this precond must be introduced. Note that
set_browse_value_context is called by compute_browse_result_from_source,
with p_maxTargetRef = 0. Thus the precond is verified.

For set_browse_value_context_from_continuation_point: this precond is
verified by previous call of getall_continuation_point.

message:
Ticket #1062: Update precond of treat_one_translate_browse_path

The operation treat_one_translate_browse_path calls the operation
write_BrowsePath_Res_StatusCode. This latter requires that the input
parameter browsePath belongs to dom(BrowsePath_Res_StatusCode).
This precond is verified when alloc_browse_path_result ends with
success : 'dom(BrowsePath_Res_StatusCode) = BrowsePaths'. In addition,
BrowsePath_Res_X have the same domain (specified in the invariant).
Therefore, 'dom(BrowsePath_Res_NbTargetMax) = BrowsePaths' is added into
precond of treat_one_translate_browse_path.

namespace prefix 'ns1'. This namespace cannot be parsed by the Python
parser as it is considered 'for internal use only' !

Declare the UA Types namespace explicitly in the first merged file, with
a 'uax' prefix.

Add a test to verify that calling a merge, then calling it again on the
result with no arguments, produces an identical file and adds the
missing UA Types namespace declaration, with no error.

message:
Ticket #690: B model: change strategy to support +25% of max nb SCs

In case we reach the maximum number of simultaneous SCs, we keep +25% SCs slot to establish new SCs and try to remove old one.
If no old one can be closed to accept a new one, the new one is closed.
Thus maximum number of simultaneous SCs is in fact the one configured, +25% slots are only use as temporary buffer.

author: monfort <vincent.monfort@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #623: server SC key renewal bugfix: in key renewal transitory case, server uses old tokenId with new key sets

On server side, after sending the OPN renew response. The new security key set and associated tokenId is available as current key set but is not yet activated.
Its activation occurs only after the first client request with the new tokenId (and use of new security key sets associated). Therefore if the server shall send a response before the activation of the new key sets it shall use the old tokenId and security key sets associated.

Before this fix the server was using the old tokenId as expected but the new security key sets were used instead of previous one.
It leads the message signature to be invalid in sign mode and the messsage encryption and signature to be invalid in sign&encrypt mode.

The operation compute_browse_result is promoted from browse_treatment to

translate_browse_path_result for the op compute_browse_result.

translate_browse_path_result.
- the precond related to isBrowseResultAllocated shall be copied from
browse_treatment to translate_browse_path_result for compute_browse_result.
- the postcond of getall_and_move_browse_result shall be updated to take
into account of isBrowseResultAllocated.

message:
Ticket #1062: Correct postcond of treat_browse_request_BrowseValues

In the postcond of treat_browse_request_BrowseValues, the second
'forall' predicate is not correct as the status
e_sc_bad_no_continuation_points is not taken into account.

Moreover, PO generated by the use of the 'forall' predicate are too
complicated to be proved either automatically or by user rules.
Therefore, 'forall' predicates are removed and the postcond is
rewritten. Note that predicates in this rewriting are not equivalent to
the original 'forall' predicates, but they observe the implementation of
the operation.

message:
Ticket #629: Event handler enhancement: use a uintptr_t instead of void* for params

It is only guaranteed by C99 that conversion void* => uintptr_t => void* is valid but not uintptr_t => void* => uintptr_t.
Using uintptr_t instead of void* therefore allows to store either an uintptr_t or a void*, whereas using a void* does not allow to store a uintptr_t.

message:
Ticket #1152: Correct init value of continuation points

Variables modeling continuation points are s_ContinuationPoints,
id_ContinuationPoint and ContinuationPoint_session. In the
INITIALISATION and in operation continuation_points_UNINITIALISATION,
these variables are set to "{}" using "Becomes Element of" substitution.
This is not correct. One of the solution is replacing "Becomes Element
of" by "Becomes Equal".  There is a subtle case for basic machine where
such a change hits a bug in the b2c translator. We work around it by
using the most general kind of substitution.

message:
Ticket #743: update build/mingw/check docker to integrate check 0.14 and expat 2.2.9 (with CMake config files)

For mingw docker:
When adding mbedtls/check libraries installed in the standard libraries of mingw, some headers of mingw seem to be included as well.
E.g.: mbedtls headers mbedtls/*.h are installed in /usr/i686-w64-mingw32/include/ which is considered the mbedtls include path since we use "#include mbdetls/<header.h>". When building code dependant on mbedtls this path is included and leads to include mingw headers that are not supposed to be.
It has (at least) for consequence to make fail tests sopc_ieee_check.h verication on float representation.
The current fix consists to install the mbedtls/check libraries in separate paths from mingw standard libraries to avoid including the mingw standard libraries directory to compile.

its sub-operation treat_one_translate_browse_path_1_1 are updated.

Ticket #607: UACTT: adapt configuration to use security in SC

1) Configure UACTT with S2OPC certificates: trust list is certificates from S2OPC, client certificates are S2OPC client certificates.
Otherwise we need to copy the S2OPC server certificate in UACTT trust list and set the UACTT client certificate as only valid certificate (we do not manage list but use unique CA trusted certificate instead)

2) Configure UACTT to always use a secured SC. It is necessary otherwise tests using security are failing because of wrongly configured data in UACTT (seems to be a bug).

author: Adrien Bustany <adrien.bustany@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #447: Clear SOPC_AddressSpaceItem values in SOPC_AddressSpace_Delete

When using an embedded address space, the items should not be freed,
since they where not malloced. Their values however can have been
modified at runtime, and need to be freed in any case.

We address this by setting the "DoNotClear" flag on item values embedded
in the binary, this flag gets reset when the value is changed at
runtime. By setting the SOPC_Dict from the address space to clear all
values in its free function, we ensure that all malloc'ed values are
cleared when the address space is freed.

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1062: Update precond of treat_browse_request_X

The operation treat_browse_request_BrowseValue_1 calls set_browse_value_context
and compute_browse_result that require 'isBrowseValueContextDefined =
FALSE' and 'isBrowseResultComputed = FALSE' as precond. Indeed, for each
treatment of a browse request, the variables isBrowseValueContextDefined and
isBrowseResultComputed are reset. Therefore, the above predicates are
added into precond of the operation treat_browse_request_BrowseValue_1.

These predicates are also brought up into the calling operation
treat_browse_request_BrowseValues : the precond of the operation
specification and WHILE loop invariant are updated.

message:
Ticket #1152: Update typing of 'next' in iterators

Specification of some iterators use 'next' and increase it for each
loop. Variables 'next' being bound (NAT1), a non overflow PO must be
proven at the exit of the last iteration of the loop (<= MAXINT).
This PO is unprovable.

As the 'next' variables are abstract, they can be typed by unbounded
integer set NATURAL1. As 'next' is assigned to an output parameter of
operations 'continue_iter_', the output parameter must be typed with an
implementable type (NAT1) in a before-after predicate.

This commit also removes redundant precond 'nb_browsePathSourceIdx_max_refs > 0'
from the operation 'continue_iter_browsePathSourceIdx'

message:
Ticket #447: Use a hash table as a backing store for the address space

* Adapt the address space base machine to use a SOPC_Dict as the backing
  store for the address space.
* Drop the old address space generator, and switch to the Python based
  one. This allows dropping Java from our build dependencies, and to get
  a better integration with CMake (the s2opc_embed_address_space CMake
  function can be distributed to users).
* Switch all test/demo programs to the new infrastructure for address
  space loading.
* Remove the SOPC_AddressSpace_Description class, we now deal with
  SOPC_AddressSpace directly during address space loading. As a result,
  we can rename SOPC_AddressSpace_Description_Item to
  SOPC_AddressSpace_Item.

author: monfort <vincent.monfort@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1274: SC layer: ensure internal send message is not interupted by extern event

Since sending an OPC UA message is done in 2 times: 1 external event received, 1 internal event triggered and then 1 internal event received.
It is possible that a SC_SERVICE_SND_MSG event is treated but another external event close the secure channel before the associated INT_SC_SND_MSG_CHUNKS internal event generated is treated.
But on an external point of view we want to be able to rely on the external event enqueued to ensure a message is sent prior to SC is closed (ApplyChanges method call request expecteds response to be sent).

As a consequence, use the SOPC_SecureChannels_EnqueueInternalEventAsNext to ensure internal event is treated in priority for sending messages.
Note: it cannot preempt an internal close event channel since it is emitted by the same thread

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1363: Correct op treat_browse_result_one_source_1

In the current implementation of treat_browse_result_one_source_1, the
browse result node Id is added to BrowsePathResult if its browse name
matches the target name. This leads to unprovable PO of preservetion of
imported machine invariant ran(BrowsePathResult) <: dom(conv_ExpandedNodeId_NodeId).

As the current B model does not deal with the case when the browse name
is out of date (cf. Table 167 of OPC UA Part 4 : local Server might not
continuously monitor the remote Server for changes), the above check of the
target name against the browse name is sufficient in the point of view
of protocol implementation. However, the operation shall be corrected in
order to :
 - Cover the specification of OPC UA even if the out of date of browse
   name has not been implemented yet,
 - Make the above PO provable.

The correction includes :
 - first of all, check if the server is local (expanded node Id can be converted
 into node Id),
 - then check if the browse name matches the looking target name.

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1152: Correct OP get_optional_fields_ReferenceDescription

The operation get_TypeDefinition is called in browse_treatment_1_i by
the op get_optional_fields_ReferenceDescription. In this latter, the PO
related to pre-cond 'p_node : dom(Ref_HasTypeDefinition)' is unprovable.

Indeed, a reference has type definition only if its node class is either
'Object' or 'Variable'. However, there is no information confirming this
condition from the calling operations (fill_browse_result_ref, which is
called by fill_browse_result). This issue can be corrected by :
- adding check of node class before calling get_TypeDefinition in the
implementation of get_optional_fields_ReferenceDescription
- adding check of node class in the specification of the operation
get_optional_fields_ReferenceDescription

The implementation of get_optional_fields_ReferenceDescription is also
simplified by assigning 'indet' values at the beginning of the
operation.

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1363: Fix memory leak in compute_browse_result

In the implementation of operation compute_browse_result,
fill_browse_result is called if memory allocation is OK.
- In the case where fill_browse_result returns e_sc_ok, browse results
  are computed (compute_browse_result returns either e_sc_ok or
  e_sc_bad_no_continuation_points).
- In the cases where fill_browse_result does not return e_sc_ok, browse
  results are considered not computed. However, the memory stays allocated
  and will not be freed. Indeed, browse result memory freeing is performed by
  clear_browse_result or getall_and_move_browse_result. These operations
  are called only if compute_browse_result returns e_sc_ok or
  e_sc_bad_no_continuation_points.

Therefore, allocated memory shall be freed if compute_browse_result does
not return e_sc_ok or e_sc_bad_no_continuation_points.

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1062: Correct postcond of getall_and_move_browse_result

In the spec of operation getall_and_move_browse_result of the machine
translate_browse_path, the postcond 'p_nb_references =
BrowseContext_MaxNbTargets' is incorrect. Indeed, BrowseContext_MaxNbTargets
is set for a new context and can be erased before being read by the
operation getall_and_move_browse_result. The output parameter
p_nb_references of this operation must take the value of browse result,
ie. out_BrowseResult_nb_References.

However, it is not necessary to specify the exact value of p_nb_references.
The postcond 'p_nb_references <= k_n_BrowseTarget_max' gives enough
information for operations using p_nb_references in component
service_set_view_i (set_ResponseBrowse_BrowseResult and
set_ResponseBrowseNext_BrowseResult).

Therefore 'p_nb_references = BrowseContext_MaxNbTargets' is removed from
the postcond of getall_and_move_browse_result of translate_browse_path.

author: monfort <vincent.monfort@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #956: Client reverse connection fix: server socket shall be associated to SC token

Associate a waiting SC with a server socket connection was not a good idea, socket index was overwritten in case of several server connections.
And since we do not know on server connection if the server is the expected one we should not restrict the number of server connections to the number of waiting connections either.
We have to wait the RHE to know if the server is an expected one or not.
Therefore the concept of secure connection token is added to associate temporarely an SC token and a socket. An associated timeout is created to close the connection if no RHE is received.
Once the RHE is received, if no connection is compatible the SC token is cleared and socket is closed. Otherwise the content of the waiting SC is copied in the SC token to keep the
SC <-> socket association and the waiting SC index is released

The same kind of correction is therefore applied to post-cond of these operations.

message:
Ticket #1363: Update precond related to isBrowseValueContextDefined

The condition 'isBrowseValueContextDefined = FALSE' is required as
pre-cond of op set_browse_value_context. This op is called by
compute_browse_result_from_source (translate_browse_path_result_i).

As the condition is not held at the level of translate_browse_path_result
and the op set_browse_value_context is promoted upto the level
translate_browse_path, is shall be added to pre-cond of
compute_browse_result_from_source. Within the same reasoning, the
condition is propagated up to op treat_one_translate_browse_path at the
level of translate_browse_path.

At the level serveice_set_view, the condition holds (invariant of the
component service_set_view_i).

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1062: Simplify postcond of fill_browse_result_ref

The postcond of fill_browse_result_ref gives details of how updating
output variables. These details are not necessary. In fact, invariant of
imported machine browse_treatment_result_bs and invariant of while loop
in the calling operation fill_browse_result have no need of such
details. Furthermore, these details generate many POs to verify operation
refinement, invariant of imported machine and invariant of while loop in
the calling operation. Many of these POs can not be proved automatically.
The postcond of fill_browse_result_ref should be simplified by
specifying only necessary predicates. In this commit, variable typing is
introduced. Other predicates can be added by further examination of
generated PO.

Signed-off-by: Laurent Voisin <laurent.voisin@systerel.fr>

message:
Ticket #1152: Rewrite postcond of treat_browse_result_one_source

The operation treat_browse_result_one_source performs an iteration over
computed browse results (which are registered in out_BrowseResult_X),
and possibly adds each of these results into BrowseResult and/or
BrowseRemaining arrays by calling treat_browse_result_one_source_1.
The specification of treat_browse_result_one_source_1 describes the
updates of BrowseResult and BrowseRemaining arrays from each of computed
browse results. Therefore, there is no need to detail these updates in
the treat_browse_result_one_source operation. Instead it would be enough
to specify that new added elements into BrowseResult and BrowseRemaining
comme from computed browse results (out_BrowseResult_X).

message:
Ticket #1062: Simplify spec of fill_browse_result_ref

The specification of fill_browse_result_ref gives details of updates of
variables, especially in function of many conditions : reference is
filtered or not, node is unknown or node is known and NodeClass is compatible with NodeClassMask, and also the succes of write operation into output browse variables. These details are not necessary in point of view of proof.
Furthermore, the use of substitution 'CHOICE' in the called operation setall_browse_result_reference_at expresses already the issue of writing into output variables : it is not necessary to duplicate the issue in the calling operation.

The specification of fill_browse_result_ref must be simplified to reduce
the number of generated PO.

Signed-off-by: Laurent Voisin <laurent.voisin@systerel.fr>

- Use sender key size for computing signature size
- Rename functions to indicate in a clear way that those sizes are computed for sending a message only

message:
Ticket #1152: Correct return codes of compute_browse_result_from_source

The return status code of compute_browse_result_from_source can take the
value 'e_sc_bad_out_of_memory' (a result of set_browse_value_context) or
the value 'e_sc_bad_no_match' (a result of get_translateStatus_from_browseStatus).
Therefore these return codes must be added to the return code set of the
operation.

Note that the value 'c_StatusCode_indet' returned by
get_translateStatus_from_browseStatus is unreacheable due to the value
of input parameter of get_translateStatus_from_browseStatus : this input
parameter takes the value of return code of compute_browse_result.

message:
Ticket #1062: Correct inv on BrowsePath_StartingNode

The starting node of a browse path can be undetermined : in the
specification of OPC UA 1.04 table 40, there is no constraint on the
characteristics of the starting node. The implementation of operation
treat_one_translate_browse_path matches the specification of OPC UA : a
check of starting node, realized by check_startingNode, is done.
Therefore, the codomain of BrowsePath_StartingNode must be t_NodeId_i.

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1363: Lift isBrowseResultAllocated to translate_browse_path

The operation compute_browse_result is promoted from translate_browse_path_result
to translate_browse_path. The variable isBrowseResultAllocated is
used in the precond of this operation. As there is no linking invariant
allowing to prove the PO related to precond deduction, precond related
to isBrowseResultAllocated shall be lifted from browse_treatment to
translate_browse_path_result for the op compute_browse_result.
Consequently :
    - the abstract variable shall be lifted to the component
    translate_browse_path.
    - the precond related to isBrowseResultAllocated shall be copied from
    translate_browse_path_result to translate_browse_path for compute_browse_result.

The postcond of compute_browse_result is also updated to take into
account of modifications of isBrowseResultAllocated and
isBrowseResultComputed.

message:
Ticket #509: user server-side: fixing user comparison in ActivateSession

Since implementation of user on server-side, the user comparison (now pointers) was always failing in ActivateSession service.

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1062: Update operation precond

The operation setall_browse_result_reference_at is called by
fill_browse_result_ref and requires 'p_refIndex <= max_nb_references' as
precond. The variable max_nb_references is updated by
alloc_browse_result. The maximum possible iteration on browse result,
represented by nb_browseResult_max_refs, must not greater than
max_nb_references allocated.
The predicate 'nb_browseResult_max_refs <= nb_browseResult_max_refs'
allow to verify the precondition of setall_browse_result_reference_at,
as 'nextBrowseResult <= nb_browseResult_max_refs' is already in the
precond of fill_browse_result_ref.

author: monfort <vincent.monfort@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #307: Bugfix Socket layer: assertion fails on socket connection failure

The problem was not visible before Ticket #330.
On socket connection failure, the socket network manager was generating a FAILURE event for socket event manager but state of the socket was not changed.
It seems that if the socket is used again for new network events before being closed, a socket write network event was triggered and leading to interpret it as a connection success (immediate state changed by network manager).

The bugfix consists to add a new intermediary state of CONNECTING_FAILURE set by the socket network manager in this case to avoid to check new network events on this socket before the socket event manager treats the failure and definitively close the socket.

treat_browse_next_request_BrowseContinuationPoint_1.

In the implementation of treat_browse_request_BrowseValue_1, the called
operation getall_BrowseValue requires that p_bvi belongs to the domain
of RequestBrowse_BrowseValue_X as precond.
These predicates are satisfied before entering
treat_browse_request_BrowseValue_1, as it is satisfied before entering

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1152: Rewrite impl of treat_one_translate_browse_path

The op treat_one_translate_browse_path calls
treat_one_translate_browse_path_1 which implements a WHILE loop.
However, the init_iter_X op is called in treat_one_translate_browse_path
and the continue_iter_X is called in treat_one_translate_browse_path_1.
This makes it difficult to establish loop invariant. Furthermore, the
init_iter_X operation, which defines the entry of the loop, should
not be used to check other conditions not related to the loop. The check
of relative path size can be done by using the operation
read_RelativePath_Nb_RelativePathElt.

Therefore, init_iter_X is grouped with continue_iter_X in the operation
treat_one_translate_browse_path_1.

In addition, a new operation (update_one_browse_path_source) is created to
encapsulate the check and addition of a new node into BrowsePathSource.

message:
Ticket #1062: Add invariant on in_maxReferencesPerNode

The operation create_continuation_point requires
'p_maxTargetRef <= k_n_BrowseTarget_max' as precond. This operation is
called by compute_browse_result in which p_maxTargetRef takes the value
of in_maxReferencesPerNode.
The predicate 'p_maxTargetRef <= k_n_BrowseTarget_max' is verified when
the browse context is defined ('isBrowseValueContextDefined = TRUE').
As this predicate is required by compute_browse_result, which is not a
local operation, a solution is adding it as an invariant of the B
machine defining the browse_treatment operation.

automatical proof.

author: monfort <vincent.monfort@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #623: server SC key renewal bugfix: in key renewal transitory case, server uses old tokenId with new key sets

On server side, after sending the OPN renew response. The new security key set and associated tokenId is available as current key set but is not yet activated.
Its activation occurs only after the first client request with the new tokenId (and use of new security key sets associated). Therefore if the server shall send a response before the activation of the new key sets it shall use the old tokenId and security key sets associated.

Before this fix the server was using the old tokenId as expected but the new security key sets were used instead of previous one.
It leads the message signature to be invalid in sign mode and the messsage encryption and signature to be invalid in sign&encrypt mode.

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1062: Update invariant on RelativePathElt

Each relative path element is defined by the following fields :
referenceTypeId, isInverse, includeSubTypes and targetName (cf. §7.26 of
OPC UA specification 1.04, part 4). Variables modelizing these fields in
B (RelativePathElt_ReferenceTypeId, RelativePathElt_IsInverse,
RelativePathElt_IncludedSubtypes and RelativePathElt_TargetName) must
have the same domain, which is a set of relative path elements. In
addition, relative path elements are determined by relative path, which
is modelized by RelativePath_RelativePathElt.

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1062: Correct inv related to in_maxReferencesPerNode

In the component browse_treatement, the invariant related to the size of
in_maxReferencesPerNode 'in_maxReferencesPerNode <=
k_n_BrowseTarget_max' when a context is defined is incorrect. Indeed,
in_maxReferencesPerNode takes the value of requestedMaxReferencesPerNode
(OPC UA v1.04 (table 34)) when defining a context w.r.t a browse request
message. The only constraint on requestedMaxReferencesPerNode is its
type UInt32. The implementation in C of get_browse_request_params
(msg_browse_bs) confirms this statement.

Note that the size of browse results is limited by k_n_BrowseTarget_max.
This limitation is treated in the operation compute_browse_result by
calling min_nb_result_refs.

Therefore, the above invariant must be deleted.

for the browse path which is the input parameter of the operation. The
domain of BrowsePath_Res_X stays unchanged (and is equal to BrowsePaths).

to the domain of BrowsePath_Res_X.

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1152: Rewrite translate_browse_path architecture

The translate_browse_path_i component should be rewritten as its size is
too big. One solution is to re-organize operations implementing
breadth-first-search of browse path when computing browse results.
The search uses variables BrowsePathSource, BrowsePathResult and
BrowsePathRemaining, which are initially encapsulted in the component
translate_browse_path_1. The re-organization is done as follows :
- Create the translate_browse_path_result module encapsulating operations
related to access / update of BrowsePathResult and BrowsePathRemaining.
- Create the translate_browse_path_source module encapsulating operations
related to access of BrowsePathSource and some basic operations related
to update of this variable. Not all update BrowsePathSource operations
can be integrated in this module : in fact, the update of BrowsePathSource
depends on BrowsePathResult and vice-versa. The SEES link is not
symmetric. The choice in this re-organisation is that
translate_browse_path_result SEES translate_browse_path_source.

This re-organisation results in modifications:
- Operations in translate_browse_path_1 are dispatched to
translate_browse_path_source_1 and translate_browse_path_result_1.
- Some local operations in translate_browse_path_i are dispatched to
translate_browse_path_source and translate_browse_path_result. The
component translate_browse_path_i keeps the sequencing of process of
BrowsePathSource and BrowsePathResult and some update operations for
BrowsePathSource.

message:
Ticket #1062: Add invariant into service_set_view

The treatment of each browse request is encapsulated in the local
operations treat_browse_request_BrowseValue_1 and
treat_browse_next_request_BrowseContinuationPoint_1. Indeed, a new
browse context is defined, new browse results are computed,
and messages related to the browse context and the computed browse
results are reset after each treatment.
Therefore, the predicates 'isBrowseValueContextDefined = FALSE' and
'isBrowseResultComputed = FALSE' are always TRUE.

These predicates are added into the invariant of service_set_view to
satisfy precond of local operations.

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1062: Correct inv related to in_BrowseValue_NodeId

In the machine browse_treatment_context, the invariant
'isBrowseValueContextDefined = TRUE => in_BrowseValue_NodeId : t_NodeId'
is incorrect :
- in_BrowseValue_NodeId is set by setall_browse_value_context with the
parameter p_nodeId. This parameter can be obtained from the input
parameter p_nodeId of set_browse_value_context at the level of
browse_treatment component. This parameter is obtained from the result
of the operation get_BrowsePathSource, which is called in the level
translate_browse_path. As the result of get_BrowsePathSource can be
c_NodeId_indet, the parameter p_nodeId can not be typed with t_NodeId.

- in_BrowseValue_NodeId is used by getall_browse_value_context with the
output parameter p_nodeId. This output is used in the operation
compute_browse_result at the level of browse_treatment, by the input
parameter of the following operations :
  + getall_SourceNode_NbRef : the implementation of this operation shows
  that the typing t_NodeId is not required by calling
  readall_AddressSpace_Node.
  + create_continuation_point : the implementation of this operation
  shows that the typing t_NodeId is not required by realizing the check
  'c_NodeId_indet' in the implementation of
  create_continuation_point_bs.

The invariant must be removed. Related operation precond are also
removed.
Note that in the operation set_browse_value_context at the level
translate_browse_path, the precond 'p_nodeId : t_NodeId' is kept :
this operation is called at the level service_set_view in which a check
'e_sc_bad_node_id_invalid'.

author: monfort <vincent.monfort@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #547: Minor change: timeoutHint verification is not required to use request timestamp

We used the request timestamp to check the elapsed time since request was sent in order to evaluate the timeoutHint of publihs requets.
Since it is not required by the OPCUA spec part 4, we should not use the request timestamp and only use the current local time as reference for timeout.
It avoids clock synchronization issue between client and server.

OPC UA spec part 4:
- request timestamp definition:
  "The time the Client sent the request. The parameter is only used for diagnostic and logging purposes in the server."
  => i.e.: the server shall not use it for a functional behavior (e.g.: compute publish request timeout ...)
- request timeoutHint definition:
  "For a Server this timeout is only a hint and can be used to cancel long running operations to free resources."
  "The Server shall check the timeoutHint parameter of a Publish request before processing a Publish response."

message:
Ticket #1363: Fix memory leak in treat_one_relative_path_element_2

In the op treat_one_relative_path_element_2, clear_browse_result is
called only if compute_browse_result_from_source returns e_sc_ok.
However, compute_browse_result_from_source can allocate memory for
browse results even if the return code is not e_sc_ok. It is the case
where the return code is e_sc_bad_query_too_complex. This code can be
obtained when compute_browse_result, called by
compute_browse_result_from_source
returns e_sc_bad_no_continuation_points.

We now call clear_browse_result systematically, whatever the status code
so that we are sure that any allocated memory (if any) gets freed.

author: Nicolas Beauger <nicolas.beauger@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1147: error for duplicate node IDs within a file

The previous implementation was detecting duplicates in various cases:
- within the source tree
- within the target tree
- across source and target trees to merge

These were treated equally, resulting in potential issues when merging
the common nodes.
Now detect the first two cases apart and raise an exception for
duplicates within source or target file: the input files are required to
be clean, they cannot contain duplicate node IDs.
The duplicates across files are still forbidden for user nodes, and
allowed for NS0 nodes.

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1152: Correct gluing INV of browse_treatment_continuation_points_i

The gluing invariant between session_ContinuationPoint and
sessionContinuationPoint_i is not sufficient to prove operation
refinement. Indeed, an element (se |-> cp) belonging to
session_ContinuationPoint~ shall belong to session_ContinuationPoint_i.

With the current invariant, if 'session_hasContinuationPoint_i$1(se) = TRUE',
we cannot prove the refinement 'session_ContinuationPoint_i(se) =
session_ContinuationPoint~(se)'.

Therefore, the gluing invariant of session_ContinuationPoint_i shall be
enhanced. The current gluing invariant is moved to 'ASSERTIONS' clause
to facilitate automatic proof.

author: Pierre-Antoine <brameret@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #455: Almost-fix concurrent memory access in asym crypto

When looking at the sources, the `*mbedtls_pk_rsa()` only copies the structures containing the big ints.

This shallow copy works, because the modified big ints (`rsa.Vi` and `rsa.Vf`) are always empty (`Vi.p` is a null pointer), so the copy contains a new buffer afterwards.
However, this would lead to memory leaks, and if the structure is used beforehand, the fix won't work anymore.

author: Adrien Bustany <adrien.bustany@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #447: Clear SOPC_AddressSpaceItem values in SOPC_AddressSpace_Delete

When using an embedded address space, the items should not be freed,
since they where not malloced. Their values however can have been
modified at runtime, and need to be freed in any case.

We address this by setting the "DoNotClear" flag on item values embedded
in the binary, this flag gets reset when the value is changed at
runtime. By setting the SOPC_Dict from the address space to clear all
values in its free function, we ensure that all malloc'ed values are
cleared when the address space is freed.

the browse_treatment component.

author: Adrien Bustany <adrien.bustany@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #421: Keep asserts enabled in release builds

CMake adds by default the NDEBUG define when compiling in Release or
RelWithDebInfo mode. Disabling asserts leads to a number of warnings
mostly because of unused variables, but sometimes because of trickier
reasons (like switch cases having default: assert(false) ).

For now we keep the asserts in all compilation modes, since none of
them should have a high performance cost (and since our deliveries are
anyway compiled in... Debug mode).

author: monfort <vincent.monfort@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #281: Encode services messages in app. thread  (+ BUGFIXES on maximum body size)

Encode services messages in app. thread:
- All chunks of a message are encoded in the app. thread before to be added in the service request/response queue to send => interface is not message structure but message buffers now
- Chain the secure message flushes to first encrypt, then write on buffer and then encrypt next chunk if necessary
- Avoid buffer copy for socket write since transport sending buffer is not accessed in a concurrent way

BUGFIXES on maximum body size:
- During OPN operations: was using a SN position == 0 in the sending buffer
- End of OPN operations: was recomputed with symmetric constraints but SN position was the one of asymmetric OPN message

author: monfort <vincent.monfort@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #307: Bugfix Socket layer: assertion fails on socket connection failure

The problem was not visible before Ticket #330.
On socket connection failure, the socket network manager was generating a FAILURE event for socket event manager but state of the socket was not changed.
It seems that if the socket is used again for new network events before being closed, a socket write network event was triggered and leading to interpret it as a connection success (immediate state changed by network manager).

The bugfix consists to add a new intermediary state of CONNECTING_FAILURE set by the socket network manager in this case to avoid to check new network events on this socket before the socket event manager treats the failure and definitively close the socket.

message:
Ticket #1062: Simplify postcond of compute_browse_result

In the postcond of the operation, details related to the update of
output variables and parameters are not necessary. In fact, these
details are not required to verify the machine invariant. The operation
compute_rbrowse_result is called by compute_browse_result_from_source,
which has no require on these details.
The details related to the update of output variables and parameters can
be removed from the proof point of view.
Another solution, which is not implemented, is bringing down these details
into a refinement.

Signed-off-by: Laurent Voisin <laurent.voisin@systerel.fr>

message:
Ticket #549: SC and Socket layer: fix multiple socket close issue

SC layer is able to send a close socket request after a socket Id has already been closed and accepted for a new connection.
It leads a newly created connection to be closed abruptly by server (between socket accept and reception of HEL msg)
Several fixes including:
- avoid SC layer to send close socket request whend socket layer already indicated socket failure
- add to the close socket request API the mandatory connectionId attribute, use it to ignore request on a previous connection

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1363: Correct pre/post-cond of treat_browse_result_one_source_1

The precond "size(BrowsePathResult) < k_n_BrowsePathResPerElt_max" and
"size(BrowsePathRemainingNodeId) < k_n_BrowsePathResPerElt_max" of the
operation treat_browse_result_one_source_1 is incorrect, because the
equality can occur. In adition, properties related to sizes of
BrowsePathResult and BrowsePathRemainingNodeId are expressed in the
invariant of imported machine translate_browse_path_result_1. This
invariant is valid as precondition of the local op
treat_browse_result_one_source_1.

Therefore, the above precond shall be removed from
treat_browse_result_one_source_1.

The postcond shall also be updated to preserve properties related to
sizes of BrowsePathResult and BrowsePathRemainingNodeId. Indeed, the
current specification does not allow to preserve these properties in
case the sizes of inputs BrowsePathResult and BrowsePathRemainingNodeId
are equal to k_n_BrowsePathResPerElt_max.

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1062: Correct invariant out_BrowseResult_ReferenceTypeId

The co-domain of out_BrowseResult_ReferenceTypeId is defined as t_Node.
However, c_NodeId_indet can belong to the co-domain of this variable
according to the implementation of the operation compute_browse_result.
In fact, in_BrowseValue_ResultMask is set to c_BrowseResultMask_all
(operation call: compute_browse_result_from_source -> set_browse_value_context -> setall_browse_value_context).
There is no information confirming that c_BrowseResultMask_all belongs
to mask_hasReferenceType. Therefore, out_BrowseResult_ReferenceTypeId
can be updated by an element x |-> c_NodeId_indet, according to
apply_result_mask_filter.
The co-domain of the variable must be set to t_NodeId_i.

Signed-off-by: Laurent Voisin <laurent.voisin@systerel.fr>

message:
Ticket #281: Encode services messages in app. thread  (+ BUGFIXES on maximum body size)

Encode services messages in app. thread:
- All chunks of a message are encoded in the app. thread before to be added in the service request/response queue to send => interface is not message structure but message buffers now
- Chain the secure message flushes to first encrypt, then write on buffer and then encrypt next chunk if necessary
- Avoid buffer copy for socket write since transport sending buffer is not accessed in a concurrent way

BUGFIXES on maximum body size:
- During OPN operations: was using a SN position == 0 in the sending buffer
- End of OPN operations: was recomputed with symmetric constraints but SN position was the one of asymmetric OPN message

functional impact on the model or the generated code.

author: Adrien Bustany <adrien.bustany@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #421: Keep asserts enabled in release builds

CMake adds by default the NDEBUG define when compiling in Release or
RelWithDebInfo mode. Disabling asserts leads to a number of warnings
mostly because of unused variables, but sometimes because of trickier
reasons (like switch cases having default: assert(false) ).

For now we keep the asserts in all compilation modes, since none of
them should have a high performance cost (and since our deliveries are
anyway compiled in... Debug mode).

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1363: Update inv related to BrowsePathResult / Remaining

In the component translate_browse_path_result_1 :
- The inv "c_ExpandedNodeId_indet /: ran(BrowsePathResult)" is not
  necessary as we have "ran(BrowsePathResult) <:
  dom(conv_ExpandedNodeId_NodeId)". Indeed, the latter is a subset of
  t_ExpandedNodeId. An assertion "ran(BrowsePathResult) <:
  t_ExpandedNodeId" is added to facilitate automated proof.
- The inv related to the codomain of BrowsePathRemainingNodeId shall be
  enhanced by specifying that ran(BrowsePathRemainingNodeId) is a subset
  of t_ExpandedNodeId. This new invariant is true by construction of
  BrowsePathRemainingNodeId and needed by operations, for example,
  free_BrowsePathRemaining. This latter requires that the nodeId to be
  freed belongs to t_ExpandedNodeId.

author: Minh-Thang KHUU <khuu@systerel.fr>
message:
Ticket #1152: Update pre-cond of op related to ResponseBrowseNext

In service_set_view_i, the condition 'ResponseBrowseNext = p_resp_msg'
is required as a pre-cond of operations set_ResponseBrowseNext_X. These
operations are called by treat_browse_next_request_ReleaseContinuationPoint_1
and treat_browse_next_request_ReleaseContinuationPoint_1.

The above condition is fullfilled by the post-cond of
alloc_browse_next_response, which is called before the above two
operations treat_browse_next_request_X. Therefore, it shall
be added into the pre-cond of these latters.

As the above two op treat_browse_next_request_X are called in a loop in
the op treat_browse_next_request_BrowseContinuationPoints, the pre-cond
is also added into the loop invariant.

message:
Ticket #1152: Update pre-cond of op related to RequestBrowseNext

The operation getall_ContinuationPoint (msg_browse_next_bs) requires
the pre-cond 'RequestBrowseNext = p_req_msg'. This operation is called
by operations treat_browse_next_request_BrowseContinuationPoint_1 and
treat_browse_next_request_ReleaseContinuationPoint_1 in component
service_set_view_i. Then these operations are called by
treat_browse_next_request_BrowseContinuationPoints.

The above pre-cond is fullfilled by the post-cond of
get_browse_next_request_params, which is called before
treat_browse_next_request_BrowseContinuationPoints. Therefore, it shall
be added into the pre-cond of the above three op treat_browse_next_request_X.

or used. DFrame instances should always be used instead.

author: Hervé Pagès <hpages@fredhutch.org>
message:
XDataFrame and SummaryDataFrame now contain DFrame instead of DataFrame

The XDataFrame and SummaryDataFrame classes now indirectly extend
DataFrame (via the new DFrame class) instead of being direct DataFrame
extensions. This is in preparation for future changes to the DataFrame
class hierarchy (see commit 36837bdf to S4Vectors for more information).

This change is transparent to the end user and is not expected to break
any existing code or serialized object.
